title: Emberwake Rebuilders
brief: Recover dungeon relics and spend them on homes, a clinic and the hearth of a damaged settlement.
players: 1–4 LAN cooperative players; local solo campaign

chapters.title: A Hearth in Ruins
chapters.story: Sera finds the village preserved in embers. Ollin asks for relics with which to rebuild homes.

chapters.title: Stones with Names
chapters.story: Each recovered stone carries a name; Mira refuses to let repairs become another empty monument.

chapters.title: The Returning Light
chapters.story: The ember lord holds the last light. Returning it will give the settlement a future beyond the dungeon.

status: development; build, gameplay, physical controller, multi-machine LAN and Steam release acceptance tracked separately
inspiration: Original characters, names, story and code; genre references are design inspiration only.
